fx.formula: native amount × (USD per EUR ÷ source currency per EUR)
fx.rounding: HALF_UP to 12 decimal places; source decimals preserved
fx.note: ECB reference rates are informational, not transaction or card-settlement rates. Rate date is the publication date; collection time does not change it.
